about.heroSubtitle: The untamed heart of Central Asia
about.storySubtitle: Founded in 2009 by a group of passionate Kyrgyz mountaineers and cultural enthusiasts
about.storyP1: Kyrgyzstan was born from a simple idea: to share the incredible beauty of our homeland with the world. What started as a small group of friends guiding visitors to Ala-Archa gorge has grown into a trusted adventure tourism experience.
about.storyP2: We believe that travel should be transformative. Every journey we design connects you with the raw nature, ancient traditions, and warm hospitality that make Kyrgyzstan unique. From the shores of Issyk-Kul to the high pastures of Son-Kul, from the Silk Road caravanserais to the nomadic yurts of Naryn — we know every trail, every family, every hidden gem.
about.storyP3: Today, our team of 50+ local experts continues this mission. We're not just tour operators — we're ambassadors of Kyrgyz culture, guardians of the mountains, and your partners in adventure.

contact.faqSubtitle: Helpful answers before you plan your journey.

faq1.q: How far in advance should I book?
faq1.a: We recommend booking at least 2–4 weeks in advance for peak season trips, especially for popular itineraries and group departures.

faq2.q: Can you help with a custom itinerary?
faq2.a: Absolutely. We design custom tours for families, photographers, adventure groups, and private travelers based on your interests and schedule.

faq3.q: Do you arrange transportation and guides?
faq3.a: Yes. We can coordinate airport transfers, local drivers, certified guides, and logistics for the full trip experience.

faq4.q: Is it possible to travel independently?
faq4.a: Yes. We can provide self-drive routes, private transfers, and local support while still helping you plan every key stop and overnight stay.
